children: Apple (AAPL) posted quarterly revenue of $109.4B; Services revenue was $30.74B, about 28.1% of total. Figures released in the company’s latest quarterly report.
AAPL launched iPhone 18 Pro with A20 Pro SoC; benchmarks show A20 Pro leads in single-core scores versus top Intel/AMD PC chips and high-end Android chips.
Apple (AAPL) launched the iPhone Duo, its first foldable. CEO John Ternus said it keeps core iPhone features in a new foldable design, marking Apple’s entry into foldable phones.
Apple plans to sell on‑premises servers to AI developers, enterprises and governments, expanding from internal use to a commercial server product for secure, local AI infrastructure.
Apple (AAPL) iPhone shipments rose 13% year‑over‑year, pushing global smartphone share to a record 21%. Growth driven by iPhone 17 demand; Apple kept prices steady while rivals hiked costs.
Apple plans in-house server hardware using upcoming M8 Ultra chips for data-center AI compute, targeting deployment around 2029 to support its proprietary server-grade silicon and infrastructure
Apple (AAPL) unveiled Siri Rewind for Apple Watch: an on‑device AI feature that summarizes wearer conversations using S11 Secure Enclave and a Secure Exclave for encrypted watch‑to‑iPhone transfer.
Apple (AAPL) reiterated focus on on-device AI, custom chips and Private Cloud Compute to deliver personalized AI while keeping data processing local or inside its private cloud infrastructure.
